segments.description: Close-up shot of cooked pasta with vegetables.
Host introduces the video and pasta recipe in her kitchen studio.
Boiling water, adding salt and pasta, checking done pasta, and straining.
Host explains the next step of cooking pasta sauce.
Adding oil, crushing garlic and ginger into the pan.
Host talks about adding onions and tomatoes.
Sautéing chopped onions and tomatoes in the pan.
Host talks about adding vegetables next.
Adding carrots, capsicum, spices, sauces, pasta, cilantro, and grating cheese.
